page.notes: Printed "exafum" (line 1) is doubtful, marked [?]; the long s is read as s throughout. The left-margin references Rom.1.19., Rom.2.14., Isai.57.20.21. and Marc.9.44. are placed beside the lines where they print. The marginal references are set in small type and have no reference marks in the text. "ipsius" at the right foot is the catchword. The page ends mid-sentence with "cum huius". Italics run as printed, from the paragraph openings through their italic passages.
